[[File:JunctionTierrelLoop.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The [[Junction-Tierell Loop/Legends|Junction-Tierell Loop]].]]

The '''Loop Worlds''' were the planets located along the [[Junction-Tierell Loop/Legends|Junction-Tierell Loop]] that ran through the [[Gordian Reach/Legends|Gordian Reach]] and [[Thesme sector/Legends|Thesme sector]]. Major worlds included [[Feriae Junction/Legends|Feriae Junction]], [[Selitan]], [[Pinoora]], [[Torque]], [[Jovan III]], [[Arkuda]], [[Gulvitch]], [[Bronsoon]], [[Povanaria]], [[Trinovat]], [[Near Indosa]], [[Presbalin]], and [[Tierell]].
